stemMd:
A rectangle has perimeter 24. Its side lengths are positive.

Quantity A: Its area

Quantity B: 36
instructionsMd: Compare the two quantities using only the given information.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The relationship cannot be determined from the information given.

explanationMd: A square of side 6 has area 36; a rectangle with sides 5 and 7 has area 35. Both have perimeter 24, so the area may equal or be below 36.
